title: I am a Man of Constant Sorrow
body:
I am a man of constant sorrow
I've seen trouble all my day.
I bid farewell to old Kentucky
The place where I was born and raised.
(The place where he was born and raised)

For six long years I've been in trouble
No pleasures here on earth I found
For in this world I'm bound to ramble
I have no friends to help me now.
[chorus] He has no friends to help him now

It's fare thee well my old lover
I never expect to see you again
For I'm bound to ride that northern railroad
Perhaps I'll die upon this train.
[chorus] Perhaps he'll die upon this train.

You can bury me in some deep valley
For many years where I may lay
Then you may learn to love another
While I am sleeping in my grave.
[chorus] While he is sleeping in his grave.

Maybe your friends think I'm just a stranger
My face you'll never see no more.
But there is one promise that is given
I'll meet you on God's golden shore.
[chorus] He'll meet you on God's golden shore.

title: Sign Of The Times
body:
Artist: Harry Styles
Song: Sign of the Times
Key: F major
Tempo: 60 BPM
Tuning: E Standard
Capo: None or 5th fret (transpose down 5)

Tabbed by: Matty Sievers
Email: matty.sievers@gmail.com
----------------------------------------------
Such an amazing song yet so simple!

From the start to the bridge (4:01) it's F for 1 bar, Dm for 1 bar and then C for
2 bars.
Then from there, the bridge is F, Dm, C and Bb for 1 bar each until 4:49 then it
goes back to
the normal progression for four bars but on those last four, you use the bridge
chords.
So rather than C for two bars before the end on F, it's C and Bb for one bar each.

This will all be in the chords below though; just giving you a basic outline
before diving in.
I'm playing this with no capo as it's fairly easy but if you aren't keen on the Dm
 or the Bb
you can transpose this down by 5, put your capo on 5th and have a fun time playing
 in the basic
C fingering postions. That is probably best if you're gonna solo this as an
acoustic singer and
need to focus on scrunching your face up when you sing. :P

Edit: Lyrics have been fixed.

Edit #2: Upon closer inspection and a few more sit downs at the piano and the
guitar there is most
certainly a C7 chord in there and have added it in. However, it also sounds fairly
 good without it so do
what you are comfortable with.

Chord Voicings, No Capo:
    F       Dm     C     C7    Bb
